answer_1.quote: IUR aims to rewrite an incomplete utterance into an utterance which is semantically equivalent but self-contained to be understood without context.

answer_2.quote: we examine RUN using the widely used automatic metrics BLEU, ROUGE, EM and Rewriting F-score.

answer_4.quote: we perform two groups of human evaluation to answer (i) how fluent the rewritten utterances are and (ii) how much IUR can contribute to downstream tasks.
answer_4.guideline: judges are asked to decide which of the rewritten utterances is of higher fluency in pairwise comparisons; workers evaluate responses following a multi-scale rating from 0 to 2 based on relevance and satisfaction.
